scope: Pre-entry-only discrimination of TP1-before-SL using features known at signal time. No post-entry MAE/MFE features are used.

methodology.features: direction, UTC session, entry geometry buckets when present in baseline trade rows
methodology.split: one shared chronological thirds partition for every pair
methodology.selectionGate: DEV and VALIDATION n >= 10, PF >= 1, avgR > 0
methodology.warning: Positive holdout results are exploratory until replicated on another unseen period.
